limits: Each baseline or candidate is a single local journey under uncontrolled host load, not a percentile benchmark or performance gate.
Attached WebView counts depend on viewport, prefetch region and content height; these observations are not a hard renderer cap.
App physical footprint excludes separate WebKit processes.
The maximum first-rich-render span is cumulative per-renderer instrumentation, not full-transcript latency or a frame/hitch distribution.
Invalidation counters record cancellation/ownership, not proven deallocation.
Same-process reopening is navigation, not network/history reload or provider transport qualification.
No physical-device performance or human VoiceOver acceptance is claimed.
